items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: He was playing like Charlie Christian's style.

ctx.x: Right. So what was going on at this time? What was he adding on to his style at that time?
I don't know. Maybe faster. Because he always was fast. But when he played "Clap Hands, Here Comes Charlie," that's when I knew he was fast. You ever hear that record?
